title: undefined-loop-variable 'num' at line 535 — NameError if loop never executes
detail: The variable `num` at line 535 is set by a `for num, instance_uuid in enumerate(instance_uuids)` loop. If `instance_uuids` is ever empty when this code path is reached, the loop body never executes and `num` at line 535 raises NameError. Although guard logic elsewhere makes the empty-list case unlikely, the static risk is real. Initialise `num = 0` before the loop as a defensive default.

title: Broad exception catch in shutdown path swallows executor errors
detail: The bare `except Exception` at line 182 catches all errors from `thread_pool_factory.shutdown_all_executors()` and logs without re-raising. Intentional in a shutdown context, but the catch silently hides unexpected errors that might indicate executor resource leaks. Consider catching more specific shutdown-related exceptions.

title: select_destinations: cyclomatic complexity 16, 63 lines
detail: CCN=16 just above the threshold of 15. The function handles retries, host filtering, alternative host selection, and in-progress task delegation. Extracting retry and alternate-host logic would reduce complexity and make it easier to add new scheduling strategies.
